content.short: 1inch aggregates DEX liquidity to optimize cross-chain swaps, routing and pricing across multiple blockchains.
content.description: 1inch aggregates decentralized exchange liquidity across more than 13 chains and provides a native bridge between Solana and EVM networks. Its tools and interfaces empower users and developers to trade, hold, and track digital assets while preserving self-custody. The system focuses on efficient routing, competitive pricing, and robust security to deliver a reliable DeFi experience. 1inch supports an integrated, transparent, and compliant DeFi ecosystem and advocates financial freedom for all.
